# Acme app

We are rebuilding the legacy Acme app in a new stack. The legacy build runs on the Legacy iPhone and Legacy Pixel and at https://legacy.acme.test. The new build runs on the Next iPhone and Next Pixel and at https://next.acme.test.

prompt: Set up a side-by-side comparison of the legacy app and the new one: legacy on the left, new on the right. One row each for iOS, Android and web, in that order. Just open them; don't change any code.
notes: The sequence requires each open in a later step than the one before: opens made in parallel land in the order they finish. The second page needs reuseExistingTab=false or it replaces the first.

pattern: one device, no comparison: no sideBySide
experience: An ordinary request to look at one simulator should not rearrange the user's panel.
rule: sideBySide only when the user asks to compare
